weekend_race.race_comments: Tyler Ankrum won the Black’s Tire 200 at Rockingham Speedway, his second career victory in the NASCAR CRAFTSMAN Truck Series. Prior to the start of the race, the following truck dropped to the rear for the reasons indicated: No. 52 (unapproved adjustments; damage from practice incident).
